english.note: This is the all-purpose Cantonese noun for a cloth handkerchief carried for wiping the face, nose, eyes, or hands.

examples.english: I bring a handkerchief when I go out, so it is easier to wipe away sweat.
examples.traditional: 出街帶定張手帕，抹汗方便啲。
